student_learning_goal: I can predict using the scale, then test with mean and mode.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can predict using the scale, then test with mean and mode.
header.character_watermark: Lucky Lou the Loon and Maybe Mae the Cat in the top-right with the 5-word scale and a calculator. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Read the scenario. Make a prediction using a SCALE WORD.
parts.visual_layout: Scenario box with the 5-word scale strip below it and a prediction line for the chosen word.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone prediction layout for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. Scenario box at top: 'Class A and Class B both surveyed: how many books read?'. Below: 5-word scale strip. Below: prediction line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_PREDICT at Part 1: keywords name the scale-based prediction task.

parts.answer_key: Any valid scale word + scenario fit.

parts.student_instructions: Look at Class A and Class B data. Find MEAN and MODE for each.
parts.visual_layout: Two side-by-side data columns and a results table for total, count, mean, and mode.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone compute layout for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. Two columns. Class A: 2, 3, 4, 4, 7. Class B: 3, 3, 5, 5, 9. Below: results table with rows total, count, mean, mode.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_DATA at Part 2: keywords name the side-by-side columns showing both populations and their mean.

parts.answer_key: Class A: total 20, count 5, mean 4, mode 4. Class B: total 25, count 5, mean 5, mode 3 and 5.

parts.student_instructions: Write a CONCLUSION using your scale word + the MEAN and MODE.
parts.visual_layout: Sentence frame with three blanks for the scale word, mean number, and mode number, plus a conclusion line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone conclusion layout for likelihood worksheet. Sentence frame: 'I predicted ___ (scale word). The mean was ___ and the mode was ___. My conclusion was that my prediction was right or wrong because ___.' 5 lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_CONCLUDE at Part 3: keywords name the conclusion sentence frame.

parts.answer_key: Any valid conclusion using scale word + mean + mode.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, design your own two-class survey question.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Summative artifact — score on rubric.
